mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info (order_no, user_id, commodity_id, amount, points, pay_status, order_status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{commodityId}, #{amount}, #{points}, #{payStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_info SET pay_status = #{payStatus}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, pay_time = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
